title: How to Add Blink to Cursor: Full-Stack Infrastructure in 2 Commands

body_markdown: The Marketplace installs the MCP server (80+ tools) only.` npx skills add` installs the server plus all 14 skills — structured context that tells your agent exactly how to use each Blink feature.
